label: GXP2170 IP phone
description: Grandstream GXP2170 enterprise desk phone for high-volume users, 12 lines and 4.3-inch colour LCD, with dual switched 10/100/1000 ports (LAN plus PC passthrough) and integrated 802.3af PoE. Max 5.4 W on its own, 9.2 W when four GXP2200EXT modules are cascaded off it.
